title: RoboDreamer: Learning Compositional World Models for Robot Imagination
author: Siyuan Zhou, Yilun Du, Jiaben Chen, Yandong Li, Dit-Yan Yeung, Chuang Gan
summary: RoboDreamer is a new method that helps robots imagine future actions by creating videos from language and images. It breaks down instructions into parts to better handle new and mixed commands. This approach improves how robots plan tasks by showing detailed object movements and spatial relations.
